ideas.title: Resolve the reliability blocker
ideas.rationale: The open incident blocks expansion and high utilization warrants investigation, but does not establish the packet-loss cause.
ideas.nextAction: Complete the engineer visit and customer update, validate the root cause and remediation, and bring the plan to the review without presenting an upgrade as a confirmed fix.

ideas.title: Validate a diverse Tuas design
ideas.rationale: The hub has a firm ready-by need and independent-path requirement, while fibre serviceability and the budget are unconfirmed.
ideas.nextAction: Assess primary and independent backup routes by the requested deadline, verify feasibility and lead time, then prepare a priced proposal for Daniel without assuming approval.

ideas.title: Reconcile renewal before notice deadline
ideas.rationale: The CRM date conflicts with the authoritative signed term, and the notice deadline precedes expiry.
ideas.nextAction: Correct the CRM and review the signed renewal and notice terms with Daniel at the scheduled meeting.

ideas.title: Investigate disputed site work
ideas.rationale: The outstanding balance is a disputed one-off charge rather than unpaid recurring fees, while the incident credit remains separate and pending.
ideas.nextAction: Obtain the work acceptance record for Daniel and coordinate the dispute and credit assessments separately.

ideas.title: Size capacity for the new line
ideas.rationale: Existing traffic has approached capacity, but the improved workaround and telemetry do not measure the future line's incremental load.
ideas.nextAction: Use the workshop to quantify projected upload demand and assess feasible bandwidth tiers before preparing the requested upgrade-only option.

ideas.title: Develop independent backup option
ideas.rationale: Priya requested a priced independent-backup option before the audit, while the current order and seller inventory do not record such a service.
ideas.nextAction: Verify existing third-party arrangements and path diversity, then develop a feasible continuity design and audit evidence for review.

ideas.title: Validate delivery and approval prerequisites
ideas.rationale: The line start is approaching, but serviceability, lead time, budget and a signed amendment remain unresolved.
ideas.nextAction: Complete engineering feasibility and obtain a realistic schedule; explain amendment requirements in the proposal without promising delivery or assuming approval.
